title: Peacock: folded to full fan

scenes.headline: The fan goes up from behind first
scenes.body: Then he turns to show the eyespots.

scenes.label: average length of a male's train

scenes.headline: Shed in January, regrown for breeding season
scenes.body: Every year, the whole train is dropped and grown again.

caption:
Before and after, no filter.

Around 30 to 40 of the eyespots on the outer edge of the train are V-shaped rather than round.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Pavo cristatus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: True pairing: both wipe halves are the same bird from one continuous clip. The annual moult turns it into a real yearly transformation.
